verdicts.reason: Smart Cities and Smart City Initiatives are a wording variant of the general city-technology trend.
Tech companies shaping privacy law; the 2020 label only drops the actor (wording variant).

Title-only 2019 entry on police adoption of face recognition; State Laws for Facial Recognition (2021, 1st year on the list) is a different claim (state regulation), and the ban and wrongful-match entries continue other 2019/2020 siblings (Bias in Recognition, Efforts to Ban). No match.
Same digital-twin definition in the same enterprise AI section; label shortened (precedent: same text, label shortened is same).

User-controlled identity on decentralized systems continues as Tools to Manage Digital Identity and Assets (individual control in decentralized apps); nothing in 2021; low certainty, 2022 tag is 1st year.

Sibling rule: Industrial Metaverse and Digital Twins (2023-200) continues the Mapped Synthetic Environments line (2021-147, 2022-184), so it is not this trend's successor. Enterprise digital twins (same definition) continue one step narrower as Digital Twin Testing for Preparedness (supply-chain use); low certainty.
Algorithm marketplaces and AI marketplaces (hubs to share, buy and sell models) are synonyms.
As adjudicated in pass 2: predicting what people will do next from video is not Activity Vision (recognising activities); no other match.

Cannabusiness Tech (2022) is printed 1st year on the list and is a broad market page; consistent with pass 2 (CBD siblings faded) and pass 3 (siblings 2021-185, -187, -188 agreed faded), no 2021 cannabis business item is carried by it.
Identical mesh-network definition; label drops the Neighborhood qualifier (precedent: qualifier dropped with same text is same).
Same text on the federal government's old technology; Overhauling Legacy IT is a wording variant.
Public entities selling personal data continue; the 2022 label adds buying (one step broader, precedent 2021-196, 2021-417).
Same text on ice sheets and sea levels; Unpredictable/Predicting Sea Level Rise is a wording variant (precedent 2019-208).

Scatter and sibling rules: the general ESG trend (3rd year) breaks into narrower items; Strategic Sustainability Plans, Supply Chain Sustainability and Shipping Industry ESGs continue 2021 siblings, and ESG Requirements (2023, 1st year, supply chains) continues the Sustainability in Supply Chain line (2021-366, 2022-358). No single successor.
Ambient interfaces in the AI creative-field section are not Human-Centric Pervasive Computing (2024, personal computing hardware embedded in objects); nothing in 2023.
As adjudicated in pass 2: EU regulation of AI; Europe Regulates AI is a wording variant.
Cybercrime moving into immersive worlds is not The Metaverse Is the Wild West (brand-reputation and consumer risk of metaverse experiments); no crime title in 2023 or 2024.
Diminished reality (masking features of the environment in AR) is not Diminished Sensory Overload (sensory support for people with autism); no match.
Experiential and virtual art continues as Immersive Experiences in The Arts (immersive multisensory art), as agreed in pass 2; low certainty, 2023 tag is 1st year.
Pressure-responsive liquid-metal material is not Smart Materials (2023, smart undergarment monitoring vitals); precedent 2022-109 (tactile skin) faded.

AUVs (5th year, 2022 Drones section) continue in the 2023 drones section as Ocean-Faring Drones, which the publisher defines as USVs and AUVs (2024-426); one step broader, absorbing sibling Autonomous Ships (merger precedent 2022-350). Oceanic Explorers is small exploratory robots (pass-2 ruling on 2023-404).

Rethinking energy delivery for battery-powered transport continues as Redefining the Roadside (charging demand forcing a rethink of the roadside business); Nowhere to Charge carries the charging-access claim.

Decarbonizing air travel continues as Air under Green Transport (2024); Decarbonizing Mobility (2023) is automotive legislation. 2023-641 (Sharkskin for Planes) to the same match is a different edition, so the sibling rule does not apply.
Fans taking ownership stakes is not Fandom on the Blockchain (fan experiences, golden records, ticketing); same ruling as the pass-1 adjudicator.

Using the permanent public ledger as proof of events continues as Tracking Intangible Value (Web3 archiving records of events and connections); provenance goes to sibling Provenance and Authentication, a different 2023 trend; low certainty.
Private 5G Networks and Your Own Private 5G are a wording variant.
The geopolitical race over next-generation networks (5th year) continues as 6G Global Competition (US, China, India); sibling 6G (2022-419) is recycled, not continued there.
Global quantum computing race and global quantum competition (US-China) are a wording variant.
Same text on epigenetic age; label drops the prefix.
Same text on pandemic surveillance and genetic privacy; label drops the qualifier.
Direct air capture at scale; label drops Large-Scale, quote is on large-scale plants.
As adjudicated in pass 2: consumers' awareness of their own emissions continues as Individual Consumer Tracking; 2024-336 (ML carbon footprint) matches the label but not the claim; low certainty.
As adjudicated in pass 2: cleaning plastic out of the ocean continues as Microplastics (2024 Ocean); no 2022 sibling continues there (Plastic Rain persists by subject).
Mycelium Revolution and Mycelium: same trend, label shortened.
Fusion Power and Fusion: same trend, near-identical text.
Clean Hydrogen and Hydrogen: qualifier dropped (as in pass 1).
The billionaire space race is not Private Missions (2024, 1st year on the list, private crewed missions); same broad field (commercial space) is not enough; nothing in 2023.

Scatter rule: Construction is the lead item of the 2023 Green Processes construction group (sector emissions); it breaks into narrower 2024 trends that continue its siblings (Green Cement to Carbon Neutral or Negative Building Materials, 3D-Printed Houses). Consistent with Heavy Industries (2023-627, agreed faded).
Low-carbon cement continues, one step broader, as Carbon Neutral or Negative Building Materials (quote names more sustainable concrete) in the 2024 Construction group.
Pyrolysis of plastic into diesel is not Plastic (2024 Recycling: wax moths digesting plastic, the plastic-eating organisms line); same broad field only.

Living concrete continues in the same Green Materials slot as Self-Healing Materials (concrete that repairs itself); the 2024 group otherwise repeats 2023 (CLT, Mycelium, Lab-Grown Leather); low certainty.
Reintroducing animal species continues as Rewilding: Animals/Nature, a merged 2024 page whose label names this item (merger precedent 2022-541 to -543).
Umbrella rule (same umbrella): the BMI/BCI/neuroprosthetics umbrella continues as Brain-Computer Interfaces and Neuroprosthetics (7th year on the list); BMI and BCI are synonyms.
